recommended_action: Reach out with a bigger save offer — one month free or a free upgrade. They pay more than the other groups and have gone the longest without logging in, so it's worth a bigger investment to keep them.
Send a simple 'come back' reminder email or push notification with a free week. This is the cheapest plan, so keep the save-offer cheap too — a small nudge, not a big discount.

Send a personalized 'shows you'll like' email based on their favorite genre. The problem here isn't that they dislike the service — this group has almost stopped watching, so the fix is getting them back in front of content, not a discount.
